title: [dataset] Software-as-a-Graph: Replication Package (Datasets, Generator Configurations, Simulation Harnesses, Model Checkpoints, and Analysis Scripts)
description:
Replication package for the paper 'Software-as-a-Graph: When Does Graph Learning Improve Cascade-Impact Ranking in Publish-Subscribe Systems?', submitted to the Journal of Systems and Software (Elsevier), Special Issue on AI Techniques for Performance, Reliability, and Sustainability of Modern Software Systems (VSI:AI4MSS).

This package contains everything required to reproduce all findings, tables, and figures in the manuscript and supplementary material:
  • Results Bundle: Complete set of 36 empirical JSON result artifacts backing all reported experiments, alongside rendered LaTeX, Markdown, and CSV tables, and figure graphics. Includes a cryptographic MANIFEST.json recording SHA-256 digests, git commit hashes, and corpus provenance.
  • Trained Model Checkpoints: PyTorch Geometric model checkpoints for all architecture variants (HGT-QoS, HGT, GAT, GAT-QoS, etc.) across 12 scenario topologies and 5 random seeds (42, 123, 456, 789, 2024).
  • Scenario Datasets: 12 synthetic publish-subscribe scenario topologies byte-identically regenerable from YAML specifications, plus 5 real-world open-source system architecture models.
  • Simulation & Learning Harnesses: Full source code for the cascading-failure simulation engine, QoS-aware graph builder, GNN training and evaluation pipelines, and cross-validation harnesses.
  • Environment Replication: Exact dependency specification (pyproject.toml) and Dockerfile for containerized one-command reproduction.
